info.about: John Romero's Daikatana, better known as simply Daikatana, is a 2000 first-person shooter action role-playing game developed by Ion Storm and published by Eidos Interactive for Windows. A port to the Nintendo 64 was released the same year by Kemco.
info.trivia: Kemco never released the Game Boy Color version in North America because it judged the Daikatana name too damaged to sell.
info.why: The N64 version began as a Blockbuster rental exclusive in August 2000 and reached shops only that November, after the PC original's notorious flop.
